name: Badge
description: Labels a status, count, or category without pulling focus: one 20px step at the indicator corner.

tone.description: Colour. `neutral` is the band with secondary ink; the semantic tones paint their soft fill and ink.

dot.description: A status dot in the tone's ink before the label

icon.description: Optional icon element before the text

onRemove.description: Makes the badge removable. Called when X is clicked.

announce.description: Opt into role="status" live announcement semantics

when: Marking item status: active, pending, archived
Flagging what is new or changed
whenNot: Real errors that need attention — use Alert
Anything longer than a few words — use Alert
Clickable filters or a selected filter — use Chip or ToggleGroup
View switching — use Tabs or links
guidelines: Under 20 characters; a longer label truncates
dot for live status, always beside words
Neutral is the band with secondary ink; tones are soft fill plus tone ink
onRemove for user-created tags only, never system labels
accessibility: The text must carry the meaning — colour alone never does
Removable badges need a named dismiss button
Badges are silent to screen readers unless you pass announce
Do not make a badge the only signal that something changed

examples.name: Tones
examples.description: Neutral on the band; the semantic tones on their soft fill.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Badge>Draft</Badge>
  <Badge tone="success">Passing</Badge>
  <Badge tone="warning">Stale</Badge>
  <Badge tone="danger">Blocked</Badge>
  <Badge tone="info">Queued</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: With Dot
examples.description: A status dot in the tone's ink, beside words.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Badge tone="success" dot>Online</Badge>
  <Badge tone="warning" dot>Degraded</Badge>
  <Badge tone="danger" dot>Offline</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: Removable
examples.description: Dismissible tags the user added themselves.
examples.code:
import { Stack } from '@/components/Stack';

<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" wrap>
  <Badge onRemove={() => {}}>react</Badge>
  <Badge tone="info" onRemove={() => {}}>typescript</Badge>
</Stack>

examples.name: Announced Status
examples.description: Looks the same, but screen readers now hear the change.

relations.note: Use Alert for prominent, longer messages with actions
Chip is interactive (clickable/filterable); Badge is display-only

propsSummary: dot: boolean - status dot in the tone's ink
announce: boolean - opt into role="status" + auto status aria-label
